January 28-30, 2027
Hilton Columbus (Easton)

Vendors are invited to purchase a table at the Annual Track & Field Coaches Clinic.

Tables are $400 when reserved by January 11, 2027

Vendor Submission

Select Login/Signup and follow the prompts.

Dates and location

The Ohio Association of Track and Cross Country Coaches is having its annual clinic on Thursday, January 28; Friday, January 29; Saturday, January 30, 2027 at the Hilton Columbus, 3900 Chagrin Drive, Columbus, Ohio 43219.

What’s included

The cost for a clinic display at the Hilton Columbus is $400.00. Your area will have a 6’ table included. You may purchase as many spaces as you wish. Lunch will be provided on Friday and breakfast, snacks, and coffee will be provided on Friday and Saturday morning.

Late payment

Please be aware that this year any payment received after January 12th will be for $500.00 per table.

Packet stuffing

If you want your catalog or flyer stuffed into our 1400 packets, you must pay an additional $100.00. These will not be stuffed without your payment. This is a monumental task to stuff that many packets. If you are planning on having items stuffed in the packets, PLEASE have them sent to the Hilton at Easton 3900 Chagrin Drive, Columbus, Ohio 43219 care of “Mike Laubacher OATCCC Clinic”. They need to be there by Wednesday, Jan. 27, 2027.

Display times

  • Thursday, January 28th 5:00 P.M. — 10:00 P.M.
  • Friday, January 29th 8:00 A.M. — 5:30 P.M.
  • Saturday, January 30th 8:00 A.M. — 1:00 P.M.

YOU MAY SET UP AT APPROXIMATELY 2:00 P.M. ON THURSDAY

Hotel

We are excited to be returning to the Hilton Columbus. This luxury hotel is located at the East side of the Easton Town Center. The room cost is $155.00 + tax per night with up to 4 occupants. Accommodations are 2 double or 1 king with a sofa bed. There are also suites available. MAKE YOUR RESERVATIONS EARLY.

We are pleased to inform you that we now have 2 overflow hotels in the immediate area. Please refer back to the Track and Field Clinic page for names and contact information for these hotels.
